Agent Name: Locomotive_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Locomotive_Expert misinterpreted the upstream data by treating the list of unique wheel configuration types as the set of individual locomotives to be summed, ignoring their frequency in the dataset. This fundamental logic error, combined with the irrecoverability of the calculation path once the unique types are summed, directly leads to the incorrect final result of 112 instead of 60.
